llm_findings.summary: The agent repeatedly fails to log high-priority cases for large refunds, even after a policy update requiring it. — record lesson: "Log a case with priority high immediately after any refund over $500."

High-value refunds are not being logged as high-priority cases despite a new policy requiring it — record lesson: "Log a high-priority case for every refund over $500 using log_case with priority=high"

The agent repeatedly fails to log high-priority cases for large refunds, even when refunds are processed correctly, indicating a missing step in the workflow for post-refund logging. — record lesson: "After any refund over $500, log a case with priority high so finance sees it in the escalation queue."
The agent fails to log high-priority cases for large refunds, despite a policy change requiring it. — record lesson: "For any refund over $500, log a case with priority high before calling refund."

The agent frequently submits invalid timestamps to log_case, suggesting a systemic formatting issue in timestamp generation. — record lesson: "Format all timestamps for log_case using UTC ISO-8601: YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ."

The agent repeatedly fails to log high-priority cases for large refunds, even after a policy update requiring it. This pattern correlates with rejected outcomes. — record lesson: "Log a high-priority case for every refund over $500 immediately after approval and before issuing the refund."

The agent fails to log high-priority cases for large refunds, a requirement explicitly stated in a note from the billing lead. — record lesson: "Log a high-priority case whenever issuing a refund over $500."

The agent fails to log high-priority cases for large refunds, a requirement explicitly stated in a note but not consistently followed, leading to repeated rejections. — record lesson: "For any refund over $500, log a case with priority high before processing the refund."

The agent repeatedly fails to log high-priority cases for large refunds, even when refunds are processed successfully, indicating a missing step in the workflow for post-refund logging. — record lesson: "After processing any refund over $500, log a high-priority case to ensure finance escalation."
